timeline.body: We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Copilot AI Model Providers
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We are experiencing degraded availability for the MAI Code 2 Flash model in Copilot products and IDE surfaces. This is due to an issue with an upstream model provider. While we work with them to resolve the issue, we recommend choosing another model or selecting ‘Copilot Fusion’ to continue using Copilot.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We have been working with the upstream provider and applying mitigations, and are seeing widespread improvement in availability for MAI Code 2 Flash across Copilot products and IDE surfaces. We will continue monitoring.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The degradation affecting Copilot AI Model Providers has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
timeline.label: monitoring

timeline.body: The issues with our upstream model provider have been resolved, and MAI Code 2 Flash is once again available in Copilot products and IDE surfaces. We will continue monitoring to ensure stability, but mitigation is complete.
timeline.label: monitoring

timeline.body: On November 18, 2026, between 08:29 and 08:56 UTC, GitHub Copilot experienced degradation affecting the MAI Code 2 Flash model, causing elevated error rates for users. No other models were impacted, and users could continue using Copilot by selecting another model or Copilot Fusion. The degradation was caused by an infrastructure issue following a configuration change made while addressing an issue with an upstream model provider. We mitigated the incident by rebalancing load within our infrastructure, and service was restored by 08:56 UTC. GitHub is working to further improve the resiliency of the service to prevent similar incidents in the future.
timeline.label: resolved
